caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot with a lid, featuring a rounded body, a tall curved spout on the left, and a large rounded handle on the right. The teapot is white or light gray in color, shaded to suggest its metallic or ceramic texture, with golden-yellow accents along its rim, spout, handle, and lid. The lid has a prominent finial shaped like a knob, also highlighted with gold. There is a wide gold band encircling the upper part of the teapot and thinner gold bands at the base and near the spout and handle. Decorative white patterns appear on the golden sections of the spout and handle. The background is a plain light beige. The word "stewart" is written in small, brown, lowercase letters at the bottom right of the drawing, alongside a small gold-colored symbol.
title: Teapot
